question: Two pipes can fill a cistern in 2 and 3 hours respectively. If both the pipes are opened together, then the time taken to fill the cistern is
solution:
**Given**:

Time taken by first pipe = 2 hours

Time taken by second pipe = 3 hours 

**Concept**:

If a pipe fill “x” parts of the cistern in 1 hour,

Then the time taken to fill complete cistern would be “1/x” hours.

**Calculation**:

According to the question,

Part of the tank filled by both pipes in 1 hour:

⇒ (1/2) + (1/3)

⇒ (3 + 2)/6

⇒ 5/6 parts

As per the concept,

The required time taken by both pipes to fill the complete cistern will be 6/5 hours.

1 hour = 60 minutes.

⇒ 6/5 hours = 6/5 × 60 = 72 minutes.

⇒ 72 minutes = 1 hour 12 minutes.

**∴**** The time taken by both pipes to fill complete cistern is 1 hour 12 minutes.**
